# Maintenance Checklist Skill

Automates routine maintenance tasks: linting, formatting, dependency updates, error checks, and file organization. Use regularly to keep your project healthy.

## Example Prompts
- "Run maintenance checklist for all scripts."
- "Check for outdated dependencies and update."
- "Lint and format all files."
